ex.t: 测量时间的新方法可以帮助控制地球系统.

ex.s: For Cruse, what started out as a way to kill time has now developed into a way to make a difference in the heart of a child.
ex.t: 对克鲁斯来说，最初打发时间的方式，如今已变成在孩子心灵中产生积极影响的方式。

ex.s: In this “book of books,” artworks are selected and arranged in a way that emphasizes these connections between different eras and cultures.
ex.t: 在这本"书中的书"中，艺术作品的选取和编排方式强调了不同时代和文化之间的联系。

ex.s: My two sets of grandparents lived in Colorado and North Dakota, and my parents decided to spend a few weeks driving to those states and seeing all the sights along the way.
ex.t: 我的两对祖父母分别住在科罗拉多州和北达科他州，父母决定花几周时间开车去那些州，沿途看遍所有景点。

ex.s: In this way, they know how it feels to walk a long distance carrying heavy bottles.
ex.t: 通过这种方式，他们体会到背着沉重的水瓶走长距离是什么感觉。

defs.def: an area, a part of a country, etc. 地区；地带
a particular aspect of sth 方面

ex.s: 7．（1分）We can observe that artificial intelligence has already made a（n） ________on our lives in many ways．（  ）
ex.t: 7．（1分）我们可以观察到人工智能已经在许多方面对我们生活产生了________。（  ）

ex.s: Yes, it was a huge goodbye in so many ways, but it was also the start of something new — an adventure in multigenerational living.
ex.t: 是的，从很多方面说这是一次巨大的告别，但它也是新事物的开端——一场多代同堂生活的冒险。

ex.s: In what way is a routine different from a habit?
ex.t: 常规与习惯在哪些方面不同？

ex.s: “One has to be impetuous both ways or they wouldn’t dare to face up to any challenge.
ex.t: 一个人必须在两方面都冲动，否则他们不敢面对任何挑战。

ex.s: Uniforms can be useful in unexpected ways, A school in Ireland has introduced an interesting new uniform.
ex.t: 校服可能在意想不到的方面有用，爱尔兰一所学校推出了一款有趣的新校服。

ex.s: It is different from British English in several ways, mostly in spelling and vocabulary.
ex.t: 它在几个方面与英式英语不同，主要在拼写和词汇上。

ex.s: It may be, of course, that these characteristics aren’t in any way surprising or singular.
ex.t: 当然，这些特征可能在任何方面都不令人惊讶或独特。

ex.s: In what way has the speaker changed?
ex.t: 说话者在哪些方面发生了变化？

ex.s: Color choices in this range are a step up from the small ones in two major ways
ex.t: 这一范围的色彩选择在小面积选择基础上有两个主要提升

ex.s: The state also cleared the way for companies to sell or rent out self-driving cars, and for companies to operate driverless taxi services.
ex.t: 政策制定者现在应该开始思考如何确保自动驾驶汽车的出现不会延续我们当前受控于汽车的交通系统中最糟糕的方面。

defs.def: a particular condition or state 情况；状态

ex.s: Either way, your apparent missteps will have moved you a little closer to true mastery.
ex.t: 无论哪种情况，你那些明显的失误都会让你离真正的精通更近一点。

defs.def: during the whole journey/period of time 一路上；自始至终

ex.s: When Jim Grant spotted black smoke coming out of a building on his way to work, he____21____his car to call 911.
ex.t: 吉姆·格兰特在上班路上看到一栋楼冒出黑烟时，他___21___车拨打了911。

ex.s: Bailey then ____27____ to let Lenoue climb onto her back and carried her all the way to the finish line, then another 300 feet to where Lenoue could get ____28____ attention.
ex.t: 贝利随后____27____让勒努爬上她的背，一路背着她到了终点线，然后又走了300英尺，到了勒努能接受____28____救治的地方。

ex.s: I’m telling you, my happy feet barely touched the ground all the way home.
ex.t: 我跟你说，我快乐的脚几乎没碰到地面，一路走回家。

ex.s: Don't swallow a meal on the way to work.
ex.t: 别在去上班的路上狼吞虎咽一顿饭。

ex.s: 68 Why did Addie feel happy on her way home?
ex.t: 68 艾迪在回家的路上为什么感到开心？

ex.s: At this moment, Paul and Beeky were driving their car on their way to Alaska.
ex.t: 就在这时，保罗和贝基正开车在去阿拉斯加的路上。

ex.s: “Again, Daddy, again!” Jacky shouts as I throw him skywards and catch him on the way back down again.
ex.t: “再一次，爸爸，再一次！”杰基喊道，我把他扔向天空，在回来的路上又抓住了他。

ex.s: Tightly holding the permission slip from the orchestra director, I ran all the way home after school, and shakily handed it to my parents with a fear that they might dismiss my desire.
ex.t: 紧紧攥着管弦乐队指挥的许可条，放学后我一溜烟跑回家，颤抖着递给父母，生怕他们会否决我的愿望。

defs.def: completely; as much as it takes to achieve what you want 完全地；无保留地

ex.s: Removing gender from the picture altogether seems like a simple way to fix this.
ex.t: 把性别完全从画面中剔除，似乎是解决这个问题的简单办法。

defs.def: to stop resisting sb/sth; to agree to do sth that you do not want to do 屈服；退让；让步

ex.s: Then I put the tomatoes and the beaten eggs into pan together.  ＂Not that way，＂ my mom tried to stop us but failed.
ex.t: 然后我把西红柿和打好的鸡蛋一起放入锅中。"不是那样，"妈妈试图阻止我们但没成功。

defs.def: to allow sb/sth to be or go first 让 … 在先；让 … 先行

ex.s: But uncritical devotion to the “way things are done” can also deny us the possibility of better days.
ex.t: 但对“既定做法”不加批判的盲从，也可能让我们错失迎来更好日子的可能。

ex.s: When I finally finished it, the thought of winning had given way to the enjoyment of writing.
ex.t: 当我最终完成它的时候,胜利的想法已经让位于对写作的享受.

ex.s: When I finally finished it, the thought of winning had given way to the enjoyment of writing.
ex.t: 当我最终完成它的时候,胜利的想法已经让位于对写作的享受.

ex.s: She goes back and forth between machines to make the drinks. _____37_____ As the customer grabs the drink from her hand, she smiles and says, “Hello, how is your day?” Even when the line is getting longer, she doesn’t let it get in the way of her genuine conversations.
ex.t: 她在机器间来回穿梭制作饮品。_____37_____当顾客从她手中接过饮品时，她微笑着说：“你好，今天过得怎么样？”即使队伍越来越长，她也不让这影响她真诚的攀谈。

ex.s: 36   , color is the key to making a room feel the way you want it to feel.
ex.t: 36   ，色彩是让房间呈现你想要的感觉的关键。

ex.s: She often asks this, and I always answer the same way—“To have Granddad back” —which usually gets her reminiscing about him.
ex.t: 她常这么问，而我也总是同样的回答——“让爷爷回来”——这通常会让她陷入对他的回忆。

ex.s: Although technology might make day-to-day communication possible, extra effort goes a long way on special days.
ex.t: 尽管科技或许能让日常交流成为可能，但在特殊日子里，额外的努力作用很大。

defs.def: to allow yourself to be very strongly affected by sth, especially an emotion 让自己陷于（某种情绪等）

ex.s: I'm a cool guy in my own way, too.
ex.t: 我也有自己的一套，是个酷家伙。

ex.s: Science provides a guide we can use to harness the way we perform these comparisons to reduce their negative emotional impacts.
ex.t: 科学提供了一个指南，我们可以借此引导自己进行这些比较的方式，以减少其负面情绪影响。

ex.s: But by learning healthier ways to manage emotions, you can regain control over the food you eat and your feelings.
ex.t: 但通过学习更健康的方式来管理情绪，你可以重新控制自己的饮食和情绪。

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，约一半英国消费者想以某种方式改变或改善自己的烹饪。

ex.s: I talked to one of the senior applicants who answered questions in a way that reflected the faith she had in herself.
ex.t: 我和一位高年级申请者交谈，她回答问题时展现出对自己的信心。

ex.s: But it was now getting real dark． If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back． My mum would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon． So I ran back home almost in the dark while trying not to get too scared．
ex.t: 但天这会儿真的黑了。如果我继续走，可能看不清回去的路。如果我不快点回家，妈妈会担心死的。所以我几乎是摸黑跑回家，努力不让自己太害怕。

ex.s: Mia, however, didn’t know it and went her way as usual.
ex.t: 然而，米娅并不知道这些，依然像往常一样走自己的路。

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过欣然接受错误、明智地让自己处于可能犯错的位置，我们事实上能克服弱点、变得更强。

ex.s: Seemingly unrelated interests are in a way connected.
ex.t: 看似无关的兴趣在某种意义上是相连的。

defs.def: to be replaced by sth 被 … 代替

ex.s: Which of the following words can be used to replace the words underlined "stood in the way of"?
ex.t: 以下哪个词可以用来替换划线词组“stood in the way of”？

defs.def: to travel in the same direction as sb 与 … 同路

ex.s: Somewhere along the way, however, I lost touch with my creative self.
ex.t: 然而在某个时候我与创造性的自我失去了联系。

ex.s: No matter what you like to do，there is a way to get involved in various   6  （activity） on Earth Day.
ex.t: 无论你喜欢做什么，在地球日都有办法参与各种____6____（活动）。

defs.def: to go well for you; to be in your favour 事情

ex.s: One of the major headaches for her was finding her way in the huge school building.
ex.t: 对她来说，最头疼的事情之一就是在巨大的校舍里找路。

defs.def: to become lost 迷失方向；迷路

ex.s: They have lost their way.
ex.t: 我们花了大约3个小时走完了西安城墙的全程48。

defs.def: to forget or move away from the purpose or reason for sth 忘记宗旨；背离 … 的意图
going or coming 即将去（或来）；就要去（或来）

ex.s: Once, a young woman, who was on her way to visit her family in South Africa, told me she was expecting her first baby.
ex.t: 一次，一位正要去南非探望家人的年轻女子告诉我，她怀上了第一个孩子。

ex.s: To enjoy the scenery on the way.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途的风景。

ex.s: To enjoy the scenery on the way.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途的风景。

ex.s: To enjoy the scenery on the way.
ex.t: 为了欣赏沿途的风景。

ex.s: California, it should be noted, isn’t leading the way here.
ex.t: 即将到来的技术进步为城市和州提供了发展交通系统的机会，这些系统能够运送更多人，而且成本更低。

defs.def: during the journey 在路上；在行进中

ex.s: “I wanted to come up with a healthy, natural way for people to drink when on the go.
ex.t: 我想出一种健康、自然的方式，让人们在路上也能喝东西。

ex.s: It is the story of an American travelling to a strange land, and of the people he meets on his way: Rustam, his translator, a lovely 24-year-old who picked up his colorful English in California, Oleg and Natasha, his hosts in Tashkent, and a string of foreign aid workers.
ex.t: 这是一位美国人旅行到一个陌生的地方的故事,还有他在路上遇到的人:鲁斯塔姆,他的翻译家,一个可爱的24岁少年,在加利福尼亚,奥列格和娜塔莎,他的东道主塔什干,以及一串外援工人.

defs.def: not yet born 婴儿

ex.s: Pushchairs and wheelchairs are available to rent at the Information Desk and Denny Way entrance.
ex.t: 婴儿车和轮椅可在问讯台和 Denny Way 入口处租用。

defs.def: in the opposite position, direction or order 颠倒过来；相反；反过来

ex.s: But they must realize that the employment market is about how an employee will be a good fit for a company, not the other way around.
ex.t: 但他们必须意识到，就业市场关乎员工如何契合公司，而非相反。

defs.def: the opposite situation 相反的情况

ex.s: However, another way the cats are able to distinguish between situations is by looking for familiar smells.
ex.t: 不过，猫还能通过寻找熟悉的气味来区分不同的情况，这是它们的另一种方式。

ex.s: Some nouns and adjectives can be used as verbs, or the other way round.
ex.t: 一些名词和形容词可以用作动词,或者相反的圆形.

defs.def: no longer stopping sb from moving or doing sth 不再挡路；不再碍事

ex.s: Readers will encounter not only stories they have heard before, but some new stories and a moving discussion of the responsibility of the engineer to the public and the ways young engineers can be helped to grasp them.
ex.t: 读者不仅会读到他们以前听过的故事，还会读到一些新故事，以及关于工程师对公众的责任、以及如何帮助年轻工程师理解这些责任的感人讨论。

defs.def: finished; dealt with 结束；处理完

ex.s: After our third run Andrew shut down the engine, and we went our separate ways — he for a lunch break, I to explore the city.
ex.t: 第三趟航行结束后Andrew关掉发动机，我们各奔东西——他去吃午饭，我去探索这座城市。

ex.s: As darkness came over the field and the match ended, the goal keeper, Juan, walked over to me and said in a matter-of-fact way, “In your home, do you have a moon too?” I was surprised.
ex.t: 当夜幕笼罩球场、比赛结束，守门员胡安走到我面前，用一种就事论事的口气说：“在你们家，也有月亮吗？”我很惊讶。

defs.def: （用于否定句）奇特的，不寻常的，罕见的

ex.s: It might sound like one long, expensive   42  , but the couple has an unusual way to make their travel   43  .
ex.t: 这听起来像是一次漫长而昂贵的   42  ，但这夫妇有一种不同寻常的方式来使他们的旅行   43  。

very 与形容词连用
